title: Job alert: night attendant at Bell Lane Laundromat
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, suburban American home at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: You've been hired. Rule one: lock up at midnight.

scenes.narration: You've been hired. Rule one: lock up at midnight.

shots.prompt: empty twenty-four hour laundromat at night, rows of washing machines, one flickering fluorescent tube, no people

scenes.narration: Welcome to Bell Lane Laundromat. Night shift. Read these carefully. Rule two: if a machine runs empty, let it finish.

shots.prompt: laundromat washing machine spinning with nothing inside, dim light

scenes.narration: Rule three: the lost property shelf is not yours. Never fold the gray coat. Rule four: you will hear someone say your name. Don't turn around.

shots.prompt: shelf of lost clothes in a laundromat, a gray coat hanging alone, shadows

scenes.narration: Rule five: customers never come after one. If someone walks in, smile. Tell them we're closed. They will thank you. Then leave.

shots.prompt: glass door of a laundromat at night with fog outside and a blurred shape behind it

scenes.narration: Rule six: the dryer at the back is broken. If you hear tumbling, that is normal. If you hear knocking from inside, that is not.

shots.prompt: old dryer at the back of a laundromat, round window dark, flickering light above

scenes.narration: Rule seven: your coworker Dana works the morning shift. If Dana is here at night, do not speak to her. Dana quit last year.

shots.prompt: empty laundromat counter with a time clock and a coat hook, cold light, no people

scenes.narration: Rule eight: you can break any rule above. Rule one has always been optional. The door locked from outside at 11:58. You are the last customer.

shots.prompt: laundromat door with the lock turning by itself, dark window, no people

scenes.narration: So tell me. Fold the gray coat, or answer when it calls?

shots.prompt: empty twenty-four hour laundromat at night, rows of washing machines, one flickering fluorescent tube, no people

post.caption: Job alert: we're looking for a night attendant 🇺🇸🇬🇧 Bell Lane Laundromat. Rule one: lock up at midnight… 🧺 Coat or call? Part 2 soon? Let us know below #horrortok #storytime #horrorstoriestok #scarystories #fyp
